context.body: The bounded canonical source is Ezra 9:5–15; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.

observations.body: Ezra falls with torn garments, speaks of guilt rising to heaven, recalls brief favor and surviving remnant, and names present marriage trespass.
observations.label: Ezra carries communal shame into confession: action

payload.posture: Read Ezra 9:5–15 as exile, memory, and return evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The prayer speaks “our” guilt though Ezra did not narrate the marriages as his own act, and the later response raises further human costs.
